name: GatherHQ
description: GatherHQ connects Claude to your voice-of-customer research through Emma, Gather's AI research teammate. Ask in plain language and Emma scopes and launches real research studies (proposing a research plan and interview guide for your approval before fielding), pulls findings, quotes, and insights from completed studies, chats with buyer personas grounded in real interview responses, and turns results into content like reports, decks, blog posts, and ad creatives. Emma keeps context across the conversation, so follow-ups and approvals work naturally. Built for marketing and research teams who want customer evidence on demand instead of waiting weeks for a study.

_published_faq.name: How do I add GatherHQ to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add GatherHQ to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://share.gatherhq.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the GatherHQ MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: GatherHQ provides these MCP tools: ask_emma.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to GatherHQ?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to GatherHQ in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
GatherHQ requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
GatherHQ is developed by GatherHQ. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
